lastCompletedStory.title: Add merit-over-cost rule to subagent-reviewer (both copies)

nextStoryContext: Added a new '### Conventions' checklist bullet ('Merit over cost.') to both .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md and templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, verbatim-identical in both copies including the dictated shared sentence ('This rule limits the quality of the recommendation, not its scope: Simplicity remains the scope limiter. No pattern-records.jsonl exists yet in this repo (grep for dual-copy/subagent-reviewer/embed-vendor/self-hosting returned nothing), so appliedPatternIds is empty.
